verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs explicitly list dedicated sections for Vision & OCR, Speech recognition (Whisper) and TTS, and Image & Video Generation (FLUX, Stable Diffusion, text-to-video) alongside LLM chat, all under the same API/platform. missing for 10: no independent hands-on developer confirmation of calling these non-text endpoints (only first-party docs), and no explicit example code snippets for vision/audio/image calls in the pack.
